limits.title: Limitations
caption.cited_sources: Sources recorded against the study's own processes and parameters
caption.researched_sources: Web sources consulted for this study, recorded by the research tools
limits.review_ran: An internal model review was carried out on {date}.
limits.review_counts: Of its findings, {fixed} were fixed, {rejected} rejected with reasons, and {open} remain open.
limits.review_stale: The model has been modified since that review.
limits.no_uncertainty: No quantitative uncertainty analysis (for example a Monte Carlo simulation) was carried out; the results are point values.
limits.method_mismatch: Under {field}, the study names {named}, while it was assessed with {used}. One of the two is out of date.
limits.review_not_run: Under {field}, the study states that an internal model review was carried out. No review is recorded for this model, so either it was never run or its result was not kept.
limits.no_data_quality: No formal data quality assessment was documented for the datasets used.
limits.no_critical_review: No critical review as described in ISO 14044 §7 is recorded for this study.
limits.no_sensitivity: No scenarios were varied, so the sensitivity of the results to the assumptions was not quantified.
limits.none: Uncertainty, data quality, sensitivity and critical review are all documented for this study; no further limitations are declared here.
limits.iso_review_required: This report states a comparative assertion and is intended for disclosure to the public. ISO 14044 §7.3.3 requires such an assertion to be subjected to a critical review by interested parties; no such review is recorded for this study.
